subject.title: feat(ui): redesign Ask OpenClaw — mascot, shared surface, dockable panel

question: Should Ask OpenClaw become a persistent dockable companion across Control UI routes, with its browser-stored panel position and size retained between visits?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-facing workspace mode rather than a narrow repair; it changes the intended ownership and visibility model for an existing agent conversation.

options.title: Sponsor the docked companion
options.body: Accept the persistent cross-route panel model after current-head transition and persistence proof confirms the intended UX.

options.title: Keep Ask OpenClaw page-scoped
options.body: Limit the work to the visual and layout improvements on the existing Settings page, leaving the new panel out of this change.

options.title: Narrow the persistence contract
options.body: Keep the docked panel but make its lifetime or stored layout behavior explicit before landing.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the docked companion
recommendation.body: Accept the persistent cross-route panel model after current-head transition and persistence proof confirms the intended UX.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history ties this person to both the current implementation and the merged page-context prerequisite.
